segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // `messages` is a list of `Identifiable` `Message`s that have a // `subject`. // `vipMessages` is a filtered version of that list containing only // messages from VIPs. ScrollView { LazyVStack { ForEach(messages) { message in MessageView(message) } } } .accessibilityElement(children: .contain) .accessibilityRotor("VIPs", entries: vipMessages, entryLabel: \.subject) ```
